data.professional_title: Assistant Vice President | Enterprise Data Governance | Data Quality | Risk & Controls | Regulatory Compliance
data.summary:
Assistant Vice President with 16+ years of progressive experience across global investment banking, specializing in Enterprise Data Governance, Data Quality, Risk & Controls, Regulatory Compliance, and Portfolio Governance.
Proven expertise in designing and strengthening governance frameworks that enhance data integrity, improve control effectiveness, and ensure compliance with BCBS 239, GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and enterprise Data Management standards.
Demonstrated success in leading independent KPI validation, Governance Risk Assessments, Core Data Management Standards (CDMS) adherence reviews, Critical Data Elements (CDEs) governance, and Data Stewardship validation to improve governance accountability, audit readiness, and executive confidence in enterprise reporting.
A trusted partner to senior stakeholders across Technology, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and Business functions, driving governance transformation, regulatory remediation, executive reporting, and reporting automation through Clarity PPM, SAP Business Intelligence, and AI-enabled solutions.
Recognized for delivering measurable improvements in governance maturity, data quality, operational efficiency, and decision-making across complex global banking environments.
Elevated enterprise data governance and KPI assurance frameworks, driving ~20% improvement in data accuracy, completeness, and audit readiness across critical reporting.
Led independent KPI validation and control testing, ensuring robust design and operating effectiveness of data management controls with consistent senior-level sign-offs.
Directed regulatory alignment and control gap assessments, strengthening compliance with Data Management Policy and MCS standards and enhancing overall control maturity.
Spearheaded reporting automation and dashboard transformation (SAP BI / DBRIB), reducing manual effort by ~25–30% and delivering scalable, standardized governance outputs.
Influenced 8–12+ global stakeholders to accelerate remediation cycles, driving timely closure of control gaps and elevating accountability across functions.

Identified data quality issues, governance risks, and reporting inconsistencies, enabling timely remediation and improving governance accountability across business functions

audit readiness. Produced audit-ready Regulatory Evidence Management documentation, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely regulatory submissions.
Recommended remediation strategies that strengthened Governance Compliance, Data Integrity, and Enterprise Data

Governance practices. Led annual regulatory inventory recertification, maintaining governance compliance across enterprise data assets. Facilitated governance awareness sessions to promote Data Stewardship, governance accountability, and adoption of Enterprise Data Governance standards.
Stakeholder Management & Governance Leadership
Partnered with Technology, Risk, Compliance, Operations, Data Stewards, and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen Enterprise Data Governance and improve governance accountability.
Collaborated with senior stakeholders to resolve governance risks, prioritize remediation activities, and enhance Governance
Compliance across strategic initiatives.
Acted as the primary governance contact for leadership forums, presenting governance insights, Data Integrity metrics, and
remediation progress. Led governance working groups that improved Data Stewardship practices, reduced reporting inconsistencies, and strengthened governance accountability across business functions.
People Management & Team Leadership

Provided functional leadership and mentoring to junior analysts, strengthening governance capability, reporting quality, and process adherence. Support onboarding, training, and capability building, improving team productivity and consistency in governance deliverables
Review and quality assure deliverables (dashboards, reports, validation outputs), ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment to leadership expectations
Drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and control awareness within the team and across delivery
stakeholders

outputs
Portfolio Governance, Reporting & Automation

Lead Clarity PPM governance, ensuring accuracy of delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, forecasts, and RAID data. Performed structured Data Quality Framework assessments across portfolio reporting, validating milestones, RAID logs, dependencies, and delivery forecasts to improve Data Integrity.
Drive disciplined governance routines, embedding standardized reporting cycles and data accountability across teams.
Own and enhance Milestone Roadmap dashboards, improving visibility of delivery risks, slippage, and dependencies.
Delivered executive governance dashboards and portfolio health insights, enabling proactive risk identification and informed decision-making.
Validated GFMS actions, RAG status changes, governance narratives, and Data Controls, ensuring reporting accuracy,
governance compliance, and audit readiness. Implement automation for reporting and action tracking, improving traceability, efficiency, and audit readiness.
Build SAP BI reporting solutions, enhancing data visualization, reporting quality, and process efficiency.
Leverage AI (Copilot) for reporting automation, improving productivity and standardization of outputs.
JPMorgan Chase & Co.— Various Roles
Data Governance, Privacy, Controls & Risk Management
Governed data privacy frameworks, including DPIA approvals, DSIR processing, and regulatory compliance.
Maintained Records of Processing Inventory (ROPI) aligned to GDPR and global privacy standards.
Delivered privacy governance reporting and insights to senior stakeholders and forums.
Risk, Controls & Governance
Conducted QA reviews of control frameworks, improving quality, consistency, and risk transparency.
Records, Resiliency & Access Governance
Managed records lifecycle governance, ensuring compliance with retention, legal, and regulatory standards.
Delivered business continuity and resiliency governance, including testing, reporting, and plan validation.
Governed identity & access management controls, ensuring compliance with SOD and access control policies.
Performed root cause analysis on data incidents, strengthening preventive control mechanisms.
Strengthened policy adherence, SOP governance, and control documentation frameworks. Supported audit readiness and control enhancement initiatives across business units.

Assistant Vice President with 16+ years of progressive experience across global investment banking, specializing in Enterprise
Data Governance, Data Quality, Risk & Controls, Regulatory Compliance, and Portfolio Governance. Proven expertise in designing
and strengthening governance frameworks that enhance data integrity, improve control effectiveness, and ensure compliance with
Demonstrated success in leading independent KPI validation, Governance Risk Assessments, Core Data Management Standards
(CDMS) adherence reviews, Critical Data Elements (CDEs) governance, and Data Stewardship validation to improve governance
A trusted partner to senior stakeholders across Technology, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and Business functions, driving
governance transformation, regulatory remediation, executive reporting, and reporting automation through Clarity PPM, SAP
Business Intelligence, and AI-enabled solutions. Recognized for delivering measurable improvements in governance maturity, data
quality, operational efficiency, and decision-making across complex global banking environments.
Elevated enterprise data governance and KPI assurance frameworks, driving ~20% improvement in data accuracy,

Directed regulatory alignment and control gap assessments, strengthening compliance with Data Management Policy and
Spearheaded reporting automation and dashboard transformation (SAP BI / DBRIB), reducing manual effort by ~25–30% and
Influenced 8–12+ global stakeholders to accelerate remediation cycles, driving timely closure of control gaps and elevating
BCBS 239, GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and enterprise Data Management standards.

EXECUTIVE PROFILE
Assistant Vice President with 16+ years of progressive experience across global investment banking, specializing in Enterprise Data Governance, Data Quality, Risk & Controls, Regulatory Compliance, and Portfolio Governance. Proven expertise in designing and strengthening governance frameworks that enhance data integrity, improve control effectiveness, and ensure compliance with BCBS 239, GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and enterprise Data Management standards.
Demonstrated success in leading independent KPI validation, Governance Risk Assessments, Core Data Management Standards (CDMS) adherence reviews, Critical Data Elements (CDEs) governance, and Data Stewardship validation to improve governance accountability, audit readiness, and executive confidence in enterprise reporting.
A trusted partner to senior stakeholders across Technology, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and Business functions, driving governance transformation, regulatory remediation, executive reporting, and reporting automation through Clarity PPM, SAP Business Intelligence, and AI-enabled solutions. Recognized for delivering measurable improvements in governance maturity, data quality, operational efficiency, and decision-making across complex global banking environments.

EXECUTIVE PROFILE
Assistant Vice President with 16+ years of progressive experience across global investment banking, specializing in Enterprise Data Governance, Data Quality, Risk & Controls, Regulatory Compliance, and Portfolio Governance. Proven expertise in designing and strengthening governance frameworks that enhance data integrity, improve control effectiveness, and ensure compliance with BCBS 239, GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and enterprise Data Management standards.
Demonstrated success in leading independent KPI validation, Governance Risk Assessments, Core Data Management Standards (CDMS) adherence reviews, Critical Data Elements (CDEs) governance, and Data Stewardship validation to improve governance accountability, audit readiness, and executive confidence in enterprise reporting.
A trusted partner to senior stakeholders across Technology, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and Business functions, driving governance transformation, regulatory remediation, executive reporting, and reporting automation through Clarity PPM, SAP Business Intelligence, and AI-enabled solutions. Recognized for delivering measurable improvements in governance maturity, data quality, operational efficiency, and decision-making across complex global banking environments.
CORE EXPERTISE


Elevated enterprise data governance and KPI assurance frameworks, driving ~20% improvement in data accuracy, completeness, and audit readiness across critical reporting. Led independent KPI validation and control testing, ensuring robust design and operating effectiveness of data management controls with consistent senior-level sign-offs.
Directed regulatory alignment and control gap assessments, strengthening compliance with Data Management Policy and


MCS standards and enhancing overall control maturity. Spearheaded reporting automation and dashboard transformation (SAP BI / DBRIB), reducing manual effort by ~25–30% and delivering scalable, standardized governance outputs. Influenced 8–12+ global stakeholders to accelerate remediation cycles, driving timely closure of control gaps and elevating accountability across functions.

Executive Reporting & Governance Packs
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Deutsche Bank India — Assistant Vice President June 2023 – June 2026 Enterprise Data Governance, Data Quality & Control Assurance
Data Governance & KPI Validation 
Led independent KPI validation and Data Quality Framework assessments, improving data integrity, accuracy, completeness, and alignment with Enterprise Data Governance standards. Performed end-to-end Governance Risk Assessments by evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of Data Controls, strengthening Governance Compliance and enterprise control assurance. Identified data quality issues, governance risks, and reporting inconsistencies, enabling timely remediation and improving governance accountability across business functions


Delivered independent validation findings, governance risk insights, and remediation recommendations, supporting informed
decision-making and continuous improvement
Governed remediation lifecycle activities, partnering with stakeholders to improve governance accountability, control
effectiveness, and timely issue resolution. Produced executive governance reporting highlighting Data Integrity trends, governance risks, control performance, and remediation progress for senior leadership. Standardized Enterprise Data Governance practices by strengthening KPI definitions, Data Quality Frameworks, and Data Controls across business divisions. Regulatory Adherence & Policy Governance  Conducted Core Data Management Standards (CDMS) adherence reviews, validating governance requirements for Critical


Data Elements (CDEs) and identifying governance gaps to strengthen Enterprise Data Governance and Governance Compliance.
Verified Data Steward assignments within Collibra, confirming active stewardship and governance accountability in support of

Core Data Management Standards (CDMS) compliance. Performed Governance Risk Assessments by evaluating adherence to Data Management Policies, Minimum Control Standards (MCS), and enterprise governance requirements.
Aligned Data Controls with regulatory requirements and enterprise governance standards, improving governance maturity and

audit readiness. Produced audit-ready Regulatory Evidence Management documentation, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely regulatory submissions.
Recommended remediation strategies that strengthened Governance Compliance, Data Integrity, and Enterprise Data

Governance practices. Led annual regulatory inventory recertification, maintaining governance compliance across enterprise data assets. Facilitated governance awareness sessions to promote Data Stewardship, governance accountability, and adoption of Enterprise Data Governance standards.
Stakeholder Management & Governance Leadership 
Partnered with Technology, Risk, Compliance, Operations, Data Stewards, and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen Enterprise Data Governance and improve governance accountability.
 Collaborated with senior stakeholders to resolve governance risks, prioritize remediation activities, and enhance Governance
Compliance across strategic initiatives.
Acted as the primary governance contact for leadership forums, presenting governance insights, Data Integrity metrics, and

remediation progress. Led governance working groups that improved Data Stewardship practices, reduced reporting inconsistencies, and strengthened governance accountability across business functions.
People Management & Team Leadership 
Provided functional leadership and mentoring to junior analysts, strengthening governance capability, reporting quality, and process adherence. Support onboarding, training, and capability building, improving team productivity and consistency in governance deliverables
 Review and quality assure deliverables (dashboards, reports, validation outputs), ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment to leadership expectations
Drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and control awareness within the team and across delivery
stakeholders
Collaborate across teams to prioritize workload, manage dependencies, and ensure timely delivery of critical governance
outputs
Portfolio Governance, Reporting & Automation  
Lead Clarity PPM governance, ensuring accuracy of delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, forecasts, and RAID data. Performed structured Data Quality Framework assessments across portfolio reporting, validating milestones, RAID logs, dependencies, and delivery forecasts to improve Data Integrity.
Drive disciplined governance routines, embedding standardized reporting cycles and data accountability across teams.  Own and enhance Milestone Roadmap dashboards, improving visibility of delivery risks, slippage, and dependencies.  Delivered executive governance dashboards and portfolio health insights, enabling proactive risk identification and informed decision-making.
Validated GFMS actions, RAG status changes, governance narratives, and Data Controls, ensuring reporting accuracy,
governance compliance, and audit readiness. Implement automation for reporting and action tracking, improving traceability, efficiency, and audit readiness.
 Build SAP BI reporting solutions, enhancing data visualization, reporting quality, and process efficiency.  Leverage AI (Copilot) for reporting automation, improving productivity and standardization of outputs.
JPMorgan Chase & Co.— Various Roles June 2009 – June 2023 Data Governance, Privacy, Controls & Risk Management  Governed data privacy frameworks, including DPIA approvals, DSIR processing, and regulatory compliance.  Maintained Records of Processing Inventory (ROPI) aligned to GDPR and global privacy standards.  Delivered privacy governance reporting and insights to senior stakeholders and forums.  Risk, Controls & Governance  Conducted QA reviews of control frameworks, improving quality, consistency, and risk transparency.   Records, Resiliency & Access Governance  Managed records lifecycle governance, ensuring compliance with retention, legal, and regulatory standards.  Delivered business continuity and resiliency governance, including testing, reporting, and plan validation.  Governed identity & access management controls, ensuring compliance with SOD and access control policies.
Performed root cause analysis on data incidents, strengthening preventive control mechanisms.
Strengthened policy adherence, SOP governance, and control documentation frameworks. Supported audit readiness and control enhancement initiatives across business units.

logical_blocks.text:
Deutsche Bank India — Assistant Vice President June 2023 – June 2026 Enterprise Data Governance, Data Quality & Control Assurance
Data Governance & KPI Validation
Led independent KPI validation and Data Quality Framework assessments, improving data integrity, accuracy, completeness, and alignment with Enterprise Data Governance standards. Performed end-to-end Governance Risk Assessments by evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of Data Controls, strengthening Governance Compliance and enterprise control assurance. Identified data quality issues, governance risks, and reporting inconsistencies, enabling timely remediation and improving governance accountability across business functions
Delivered independent validation findings, governance risk insights, and remediation recommendations, supporting informed
decision-making and continuous improvement
Governed remediation lifecycle activities, partnering with stakeholders to improve governance accountability, control
effectiveness, and timely issue resolution. Produced executive governance reporting highlighting Data Integrity trends, governance risks, control performance, and remediation progress for senior leadership. Standardized Enterprise Data Governance practices by strengthening KPI definitions, Data Quality Frameworks, and Data Controls across business divisions. Regulatory Adherence & Policy Governance
Conducted Core Data Management Standards (CDMS) adherence reviews, validating governance requirements for Critical
Data Elements (CDEs) and identifying governance gaps to strengthen Enterprise Data Governance and Governance Compliance.
Verified Data Steward assignments within Collibra, confirming active stewardship and governance accountability in support of
Core Data Management Standards (CDMS) compliance. Performed Governance Risk Assessments by evaluating adherence to Data Management Policies, Minimum Control Standards (MCS), and enterprise governance requirements.
Aligned Data Controls with regulatory requirements and enterprise governance standards, improving governance maturity and
audit readiness. Produced audit-ready Regulatory Evidence Management documentation, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely regulatory submissions.
Recommended remediation strategies that strengthened Governance Compliance, Data Integrity, and Enterprise Data
Governance practices. Led annual regulatory inventory recertification, maintaining governance compliance across enterprise data assets. Facilitated governance awareness sessions to promote Data Stewardship, governance accountability, and adoption of Enterprise Data Governance standards.
Stakeholder Management & Governance Leadership
Partnered with Technology, Risk, Compliance, Operations, Data Stewards, and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen Enterprise Data Governance and improve governance accountability.
Collaborated with senior stakeholders to resolve governance risks, prioritize remediation activities, and enhance Governance
Compliance across strategic initiatives.
Acted as the primary governance contact for leadership forums, presenting governance insights, Data Integrity metrics, and
remediation progress. Led governance working groups that improved Data Stewardship practices, reduced reporting inconsistencies, and strengthened governance accountability across business functions.
People Management & Team Leadership
Provided functional leadership and mentoring to junior analysts, strengthening governance capability, reporting quality, and process adherence. Support onboarding, training, and capability building, improving team productivity and consistency in governance deliverables
Review and quality assure deliverables (dashboards, reports, validation outputs), ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment to leadership expectations
Drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and control awareness within the team and across delivery
stakeholders
Collaborate across teams to prioritize workload, manage dependencies, and ensure timely delivery of critical governance
outputs
Portfolio Governance, Reporting & Automation
Lead Clarity PPM governance, ensuring accuracy of delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, forecasts, and RAID data. Performed structured Data Quality Framework assessments across portfolio reporting, validating milestones, RAID logs, dependencies, and delivery forecasts to improve Data Integrity.
Drive disciplined governance routines, embedding standardized reporting cycles and data accountability across teams.
Own and enhance Milestone Roadmap dashboards, improving visibility of delivery risks, slippage, and dependencies.
Delivered executive governance dashboards and portfolio health insights, enabling proactive risk identification and informed decision-making.
Validated GFMS actions, RAG status changes, governance narratives, and Data Controls, ensuring reporting accuracy,
governance compliance, and audit readiness. Implement automation for reporting and action tracking, improving traceability, efficiency, and audit readiness.
Build SAP BI reporting solutions, enhancing data visualization, reporting quality, and process efficiency.
Leverage AI (Copilot) for reporting automation, improving productivity and standardization of outputs.
JPMorgan Chase & Co.— Various Roles June 2009 – June 2023 Data Governance, Privacy, Controls & Risk Management
Governed data privacy frameworks, including DPIA approvals, DSIR processing, and regulatory compliance.
Maintained Records of Processing Inventory (ROPI) aligned to GDPR and global privacy standards.
Delivered privacy governance reporting and insights to senior stakeholders and forums.
Risk, Controls & Governance
Conducted QA reviews of control frameworks, improving quality, consistency, and risk transparency.
Records, Resiliency & Access Governance
Managed records lifecycle governance, ensuring compliance with retention, legal, and regulatory standards.
Delivered business continuity and resiliency governance, including testing, reporting, and plan validation.
Governed identity & access management controls, ensuring compliance with SOD and access control policies.
Performed root cause analysis on data incidents, strengthening preventive control mechanisms.
Strengthened policy adherence, SOP governance, and control documentation frameworks. Supported audit readiness and control enhancement initiatives across business units.

targets.text: Assistant Vice President | Enterprise Data Governance | Data Quality | Risk & Controls | Regulatory Compliance |
Assistant Vice President with 16+ years of progressive experience across global investment banking, specializing in Enterprise
Data Governance, Data Quality, Risk & Controls, Regulatory Compliance, and Portfolio Governance. Proven expertise in designing
and strengthening governance frameworks that enhance data integrity, improve control effectiveness, and ensure compliance with
Demonstrated success in leading independent KPI validation, Governance Risk Assessments, Core Data Management Standards
(CDMS) adherence reviews, Critical Data Elements (CDEs) governance, and Data Stewardship validation to improve governance
A trusted partner to senior stakeholders across Technology, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and Business functions, driving
governance transformation, regulatory remediation, executive reporting, and reporting automation through Clarity PPM, SAP
Business Intelligence, and AI-enabled solutions. Recognized for delivering measurable improvements in governance maturity, data
quality, operational efficiency, and decision-making across complex global banking environments.
Elevated enterprise data governance and KPI assurance frameworks, driving ~20% improvement in data accuracy,
Led independent KPI validation and control testing, ensuring robust design and operating effectiveness of data management
Directed regulatory alignment and control gap assessments, strengthening compliance with Data Management Policy and
Spearheaded reporting automation and dashboard transformation (SAP BI / DBRIB), reducing manual effort by ~25–30% and
Influenced 8–12+ global stakeholders to accelerate remediation cycles, driving timely closure of control gaps and elevating
BCBS 239, GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and enterprise Data Management standards.

raw_sections.summary:
EXECUTIVE PROFILE
Assistant Vice President with 16+ years of progressive experience across global investment banking, specializing in Enterprise Data Governance, Data Quality, Risk & Controls, Regulatory Compliance, and Portfolio Governance. Proven expertise in designing and strengthening governance frameworks that enhance data integrity, improve control effectiveness, and ensure compliance with BCBS 239, GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and enterprise Data Management standards.
Demonstrated success in leading independent KPI validation, Governance Risk Assessments, Core Data Management Standards (CDMS) adherence reviews, Critical Data Elements (CDEs) governance, and Data Stewardship validation to improve governance accountability, audit readiness, and executive confidence in enterprise reporting.
A trusted partner to senior stakeholders across Technology, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and Business functions, driving governance transformation, regulatory remediation, executive reporting, and reporting automation through Clarity PPM, SAP Business Intelligence, and AI-enabled solutions. Recognized for delivering measurable improvements in governance maturity, data quality, operational efficiency, and decision-making across complex global banking environments.
CORE EXPERTISE
CAREER HIGHLIGHTS


Elevated enterprise data governance and KPI assurance frameworks, driving ~20% improvement in data accuracy, completeness, and audit readiness across critical reporting. Led independent KPI validation and control testing, ensuring robust design and operating effectiveness of data management controls with consistent senior-level sign-offs.
Directed regulatory alignment and control gap assessments, strengthening compliance with Data Management Policy and


MCS standards and enhancing overall control maturity. Spearheaded reporting automation and dashboard transformation (SAP BI / DBRIB), reducing manual effort by ~25–30% and delivering scalable, standardized governance outputs. Influenced 8–12+ global stakeholders to accelerate remediation cycles, driving timely closure of control gaps and elevating accountability across functions.

governance compliance, and audit readiness. Implement automation for reporting and action tracking, improving traceability, efficiency, and audit readiness.
